recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-28435 unless BR&R opens a later issue to change the package-of-packages modeling.
issue_request: FHIR-28435 was a Published FHIR-core BR&R change request, resolved Persuasive for R5, asking to add PackagedProductDefinition to PackagedProductDefinition.package.containedItem.item so identified packages can recursively contain a full packaged-product resource while retaining the lighter-weight approach.
initial_application: Git 0ee3e67a82 explicitly applied the issue with message text "add package as package item FHIR#28435". The commit changed the then-spreadsheet source to CodeableReference(ManufacturedItemDefinition|DeviceDefinition|PackagedProductDefinition|BiologicallyDerivedProduct|NutritionProduct) and added the matching package search parameter; later regeneration carried the target into the current StructureDefinition XML.
additional_context: FHIR-29692 later renamed PackagedProductDefinition.package to PackagedProductDefinition.packaging. FHIR-28584 was applied in the same commit family and is already audited on the combined branch; FHIR-31805 is also already represented and supplies later package-of-packages usage guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active StructureDefinition has CodeableReference with targetProfile PackagedProductDefinition, the element definition and Scope and Usage text explain package-of-packages recursion, and the PackagedProductDefinition-package search parameter points at PackagedProductDefinition.packaging.containedItem.item.reference.

related_jiras.note: Applied in the same 2020 commit family that introduced CodeableReference modeling and already audited on the combined branch.
Expanded the same containedItem.item target family to BiologicallyDerivedProduct and NutritionProduct, but covers broader scope text and was not independently decided here.
Renamed PackagedProductDefinition.package to PackagedProductDefinition.packaging, explaining the current element path.
Later published guidance explains when the recursive PackagedProductDefinition target should be used and is already represented on the combined branch.
